svg.title: News: Amazon scraps secret AI recruiting tool that showed bias against women
svg.desc: A clipping of the Reuters article of 10 October 2018, “Amazon scraps secret AI recruiting tool that showed bias against women”, cut from the archived page and laid over a blurred view of the full page, with three points summarising the report.
